film.title: Monty Python and the Holy Grail
film.synopsis: King Arthur and his knights ride imaginary horses across Britain in search of the Holy Grail, meeting killer rabbits, insulting Frenchmen and the knights who say Ni.

film.title: Airplane!
film.synopsis: A shell-shocked former pilot must land a passenger jet after the crew falls ill, surrounded by passengers and a control tower that take everything literally.

film.title: The Hangover
film.synopsis: Three groomsmen wake up in a wrecked Las Vegas suite with no memory of the night, a tiger in the bathroom, and no idea where the groom went.

film.title: Back to the Future
film.synopsis: Teenager Marty McFly is sent back to 1955 in a scientist's time-travelling DeLorean, and has to make sure his parents still fall in love.

film.title: The Intouchables
film.synopsis: A wealthy Parisian left paralysed hires an unlikely carer from the suburbs, and the two build a friendship that wakes them both up.

film.title: Chef
film.synopsis: After a public meltdown costs him his restaurant job, a chef fixes up a food truck and drives it across the country with his son.

film.title: Men in Black
film.synopsis: A New York cop is recruited by a secret agency that polices the aliens living quietly on Earth, just as one of them threatens to end it.

film.title: Mr. & Mrs. Smith
film.synopsis: A bored married couple discover they are both secret assassins, and that their next assignments are each other.

film.title: Deadpool
film.synopsis: A wisecracking mercenary survives an experiment that leaves him scarred and nearly unkillable, and sets out to find the man who did it.

film.title: Amélie
film.synopsis: A shy waitress in Montmartre decides to quietly improve the lives of the people around her, while dodging the chance to fix her own.

film.title: Notting Hill
film.synopsis: A London bookshop owner's ordinary life turns upside down when the world's most famous film star walks in through his door.

film.title: Silver Linings Playbook
film.synopsis: Fresh out of a psychiatric hospital, a former teacher strikes an odd deal with a grieving young widow: help with a dance contest for help winning back his wife.

film.title: Constantine
film.synopsis: A chain-smoking exorcist who has seen the other side helps a detective investigate her twin sister's death, and finds Hell leaning on the door.

film.title: The Shining
film.synopsis: A writer takes his family to look after an empty mountain hotel for the winter, and the hotel takes an interest in him.

film.title: It
film.synopsis: In a small Maine town, a group of outcast kids face a shape-shifting creature that surfaces every 27 years, most often as a clown.

film.title: Saw II
film.synopsis: A detective finds the killer behind a string of elaborate traps, only to learn his own son is inside the next game.

film.title: Psycho
film.synopsis: A secretary on the run with stolen money stops for the night at a remote motel run by a polite young man and his unseen mother.

film.title: Split
film.synopsis: Three teenage girls are kidnapped by a man with many identities, and one more is still to come.

film.title: Alien
film.synopsis: The crew of a towing spaceship answers a distress call on a barren moon and brings something back aboard.

film.title: Zombieland
film.synopsis: In a United States overrun by zombies, a nervous student who lives by a list of rules teams up with a zombie-hunting drifter.

film.title: World War Z
film.synopsis: A former United Nations investigator races around the world to find the source of a pandemic that turns people into fast-moving zombies.

film.title: Ghostbusters
film.synopsis: Three out-of-work parapsychologists open a ghost-catching business in New York just as the city's spirits start to rise.

film.title: Shaun of the Dead
film.synopsis: A London shop worker stuck in a rut tries to win back his girlfriend and look after his mum, during a zombie outbreak he barely notices at first.

film.title: Army of Darkness
film.synopsis: Thrown back to the Middle Ages, a chainsaw-armed hardware clerk has to recover a cursed book and survive an army of the dead to get home.

film.title: Star Wars
film.synopsis: A farm boy on a desert planet joins a princess, a smuggler and an old knight to bring down the Empire's planet-destroying battle station.

film.title: Avatar
film.synopsis: A paralysed marine is sent into the body of a native of the moon Pandora, and has to choose a side when his own people come for its riches.

film.title: Interstellar
film.synopsis: With Earth's crops failing, a former pilot leaves his children to cross a wormhole in search of a new home for humanity.

film.title: The Matrix
film.synopsis: A hacker learns the world around him is a simulation built to keep humans asleep, and is offered the chance to wake up.

film.title: I, Robot
film.synopsis: In 2035 Chicago, a detective who distrusts robots investigates a scientist's death that may have been caused by one.

film.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
film.synopsis: Tony Stark's plan to protect the world creates Ultron, an artificial intelligence that decides humanity is the problem.

film.title: Blade Runner
film.synopsis: In a rain-soaked Los Angeles of 2019, a retired hunter is called back to track down four escaped artificial humans.

film.title: WALL·E
film.synopsis: Left alone to clean up an abandoned Earth, a small robot falls for a sleek probe and follows her across the galaxy.

film.title: Mad Max: Fury Road
film.synopsis: In a desert wasteland, a drifter and a rebel war-rig driver flee a warlord in a chase that barely stops for breath.

film.title: Spawn
film.synopsis: A government assassin killed by his own side returns from Hell as a hell-born soldier, and turns against the devil who sent him.

film.title: X-Men
film.synopsis: Two young mutants are drawn into the conflict between Professor X's school and Magneto, who believes mutants and humans can never live in peace.

film.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
film.synopsis: Brooklyn teenager Miles Morales gains spider powers and meets Spider-People from other dimensions who need his help to get home.

film.title: Monsters, Inc.
film.synopsis: In a city powered by children's screams, a top scarer and his one-eyed partner find a little girl has followed them home.

film.title: Home Alone
film.synopsis: Left behind when his family flies to Paris for Christmas, an eight-year-old defends the house against two bumbling burglars.

film.title: Despicable Me 2
film.synopsis: Former supervillain Gru is recruited by an anti-villain league to track down a new threat, with his daughters and Minions in tow.

film.title: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
film.synopsis: An orphan raised by his unkind relatives learns on his eleventh birthday that he is a wizard, with a place waiting at Hogwarts.

film.title: Toy Story
film.synopsis: A cowboy doll who has always been his boy's favourite toy feels threatened by a new space ranger, until both end up lost in the outside world.

film.title: Inside Out
film.synopsis: Inside an eleven-year-old's head, her emotions try to steer her through a move to a new city, and Joy and Sadness get lost on the way.

film.title: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets
film.synopsis: In his second year at Hogwarts, Harry hears a voice in the walls as students start turning to stone.

film.title: Aladdin
film.synopsis: A street thief in Agrabah finds a lamp with a fast-talking Genie inside, and wishes himself into a prince to win a princess.

film.title: Coco
film.synopsis: A Mexican boy who dreams of playing music, against his family's wishes, finds himself in the Land of the Dead on the Day of the Dead.

film.title: Finding Nemo
film.synopsis: When his son is taken by a diver, an anxious clownfish crosses the ocean to find him, with a forgetful blue tang for company.

film.title: The Lion King
film.synopsis: A young lion prince runs from his home after his father's death, and has to grow up before he can face what happened.

film.title: Zootopia
film.synopsis: In a city of animals, a rabbit police officer and a con-artist fox follow a missing-mammal case into a conspiracy.

film.title: Bowling for Columbine
film.synopsis: Michael Moore asks why the United States has so much gun violence, starting from the 1999 shooting at Columbine High School.

film.title: March of the Penguins
film.synopsis: Each winter, emperor penguins walk for days across Antarctic ice to the place where they breed and raise their young.

film.title: Blackfish
film.synopsis: The story of Tilikum, a captive orca at SeaWorld, and what keeping killer whales for shows costs the animals and their trainers.
